entries.title: Utility predictor lost to the mean baseline
entries.reason: Held-out RMSE was 0.310 versus 0.263 for predicting the mean, so the predictor cannot justify a learned packing policy.

entries.title: Cross-encoder reranking changed no answers and lowered recall
entries.reason: At k=10 every answer was identical while source-session recall fell; the serving dependency and model download earned no product benefit.

entries.title: Always-on evidence hydration cost three times the context
entries.reason: A non-significant 2W-1L change cost roughly three times the context; conditional raw fallback replaced the always-on policy.

entries.title: Four extra retrieval signals failed to improve source recall
entries.reason: Importance, BM25 and entity weighting reduced Top-3 recall; corrected recency weighting left Top-3 unchanged and reduced Top-2.

entries.title: Predicate normalization did not repair orphaned replacements
entries.reason: Canonicalization reunited only 2 train150 signals and no heldout100 signals with a predecessor, falsifying the proposed mechanism.

entries.title: Tail-only retry recovered too little of batching loss
entries.reason: Position explained 22% of the tail-to-batch1 gap while batch crowding explained 78%; tail retry is not a substitute for smaller batches.

entries.title: Changing event annotations from since to on fixed neither target
entries.reason: Both mechanism-check questions remained wrong, three unrelated answers regressed, and the change had no measurable benefit.

entries.title: Memory consolidation is implemented but unmeasured
entries.reason: The subsystem is disabled and has no experiment establishing whether it should ship or be deleted.

entries.title: Decay and reinforcement fields are carried but unmeasured
entries.reason: Four schema columns and disabled retrieval hooks have no measurement-backed product decision.

entries.title: First dev100 pre-ingest attempt was discarded
entries.reason: The first attempt was only 37 percent complete and did not belong to the accepted pre-ingest freeze; it was explicitly replaced before formal validation.
